{{Top|leg}}
The '''Free Spacers Guild''' was an association of independent [[Starship/Legends|starship]] owners that formed in the wake of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Guild allowed the concerns of the independent spacer to be voiced with more political power than ever before.
